answer: Every identity must sink a relic into a shared reef: a deposit refundable only after forty clean epochs of settled work, stamped with a hardware serial the chain has never seen. Because the reef is public, a farm reusing one serial is visible on the first inspection, and a farm buying forty real boards pays forty retail prices. Vouching runs along a trellis of two sponsors whose own relics are older than twenty epochs, so a newcomer cannot be anchored by peers it created yesterday.
